name: Yome no Imouto to H na Kankei ni Natte Yabai!?
original_name: 嫁の妹とえっちな関係になってヤバい！？
source:
Yuusuke and Miori live their marriage happily, however one day they have a fight due to a trivial matter. Suddenly, the plans that to spend their vacations go to waste. To kill time, one of his friends recomend him a suspicious store.
There he meets Hiori, his wife's younger sister. She doesn't want to be known that she works there, so she proposes a naughty deal with Yuusuke...
translation:
悠辅与美织原本过着幸福的婚后生活，却在某一天因为一点小事吵了起来。原定的假期计划也随之泡汤。为了打发时间，一位朋友向他推荐了一家可疑的店。
在那里，他遇见了妻子的妹妹阳织。阳织不想让人知道自己在那里工作，于是向悠辅提出了一笔色色的交易……
